I was feeling dissatisfied with existing definitions of agency and self-efficacy in the psychology literature (from Albert Bandura), so I tried, as a joke, to make a mathematical model of these two ideas. This model has more truth to it than I expected! ![](/garden/files/agency-self-efficacy-model.png)

Claude's words

Related: Self-efficacy is your belief in your agency, Agency is predicting that your actions will pay off
